amendments.text: First registered run of m2_survey.py classified non-real spectrum and non-emptiness from the floating-point eigenvalues of the whole transition matrix. Nilpotent (transient) blocks can produce spurious complex eigenvalues of size eps^(1/k), so that classifier was unsound. Replaced by exact strongly-connected-component structure (non-emptiness) and eigenvalues of the recurrent blocks only, with an exact sympy audit on a seeded sample. The first-run counts (memory 2: nonreal 72164, nonempty 85894, nonempty with no period<=2 point 6422 of 94352 rules) are retained here as superseded, not as results.

Second registered run (float classifier on recurrent blocks only, with exact audit of 400 sampled rules) disagreed with the exact audit on 12 of 400; the float classifier was therefore replaced for ALL rules by an exact test (sympy characteristic polynomial, square-free factorisation, real-root count with multiplicity) of each recurrent block, cached by block matrix. Second-run counts (memory 2: nonempty 85949, nonreal 70088, nonempty without period<=2 point 6337, NB_5_cycle 135, NB_4_cycle 514) are superseded.

selectors_2D.certification: neighbourhoods via frozen RN core; certified iff every prime factor used was certified (n<3.317e24); uncertified neighbourhoods are flagged and counted separately
selectors_2D.grammar: state (x,p): p = previous vertex or None; eligible set E = N(x) minus {p} (memory=NB) or N(x) (memory=state-only); order key in {val_asc, val_desc, deg_asc_then_val, deg_desc_then_val}; rank j in {1,2,3}; if |E|<j -> STUCK (no substitution)
selectors_2D.observables: complete neighbourhood values and neighbour degrees only (no arithmetic target, no sequence-specific data)
selectors_2D.treatment: finite prime-visit counts are observations, never theorems; selectors are not claimed to be generators of any infinite family

survey_2C.enumeration: exhaustive over all subsets of realised window types when #types<=14, else 20000 random subsets, inclusion probability drawn uniformly from [0.05,0.95] per rule
questions: Q1 does any memory-2 metric rule have non-real nonzero spectrum (memory-1: none by U4.3-T3)?
Q2 does any nonempty memory-2 rule have no point of period <=2 (memory-1: none)?
Q3 do memory-2 rules reproduce, as periodic-point signatures, any of the targets (necessary condition for conjugacy only)?
Q4 does the fixed-point dichotomy (U4.3-T2) hold in all memory-2 rules tested?
survey_2C.source: U3 v001 realized_list at r=1 (embeddings of all 10 realised connected graphs on <=5 vertices)
